tasks.name: 100G Ethernet
achievements: Integrated a 100G Ethernet module for IQ streaming using vendor IP for MORA framing, UDP/IP, and MAC interfaces.

Resolved timing issues by manually optimizing GT and CMAC placement to align clock regions and achieve timing closure.
Delivered a system-level timing-closed build with full Ethernet integration for design handoff and downstream testing.
